scripts.dev: docker compose -f backend/docker-compose.infra.yml up -d --wait && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: docker compose -f backend/docker-compose.infra.yml up -d --wait && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e
scripts.docker:test: docker compose --profile test run --rm --build backend-test && docker compose --profile test run --rm --build frontend-test
